about: W5 cycle 4 (SC-3a): the reviewable table of examine-item rules applied on top of EvidenceIndex EXAMINE_RULES. Keyed by the exact SP 800-171A examine-item text (case-insensitive). class a = the item asks for a configuration artefact the control already holds (addKinds); class b = the item asks for a tenant-wide system artefact that an evidence-store read already holds but is not routed to the control (storeSources, first source with a returned, hashed record wins); class e = the item is an organisation-supplied record uploaded through EC (recordKinds, ces-org-record/1 record_kind; a record listed on the control first, then any record of the kind; storeSources is the fallback); class d = the item is not automatable (reclassify to documentary, with the reason). A rule never removes a kind and never uncovers an item that EXAMINE_RULES covers, except a class d reclassification. W5 cycle 5: a rule with requirements (800-171 numbers) applies only to those requirements and wins over an unscoped rule of the same text there; one text may then carry one row per scope.
